title: samantha-lee-mlconf-2026-travel-admin-scratchpad
content:
MLConf 2026 -- quick admin scratchpad (Samantha)

Dates: 2026-03-17 to 2026-03-19 (conference). Travel 3/16 -- 3/20 for buffer.
Location: Moscone Center, San Francisco, CA

Goals / priorities:
- Represent Redwood on booth C12, support demos + talking points for inference latency/cost story
- Meet with 5 prioritized accounts (see meeting slots below)
- Collect contact info for follow-ups and trials
- Ensure receipts and expenses done same week for timely reimbursements

People & roles (Redwood onsite)
- Samantha Lee -- booth lead, main demo, expense owner
- Evan Park -- demo engineer (GPU questions)
- Nina Patel -- sales lead / customer meetings + calendars
- Jordan Kim -- swag & logistics (arrivals, booth setup)

Logistics checklist (do not rely on memory)
- Registration: Confirmed under company seat (Reg ID: 4782-RED). Badge pickup: exhibitor desk (pickup 3/17 morning).
- Flights: UA 256, depart 3/16 08:15 SFO->SEA (actually reversed - verify) -- PNR ABC123 (verify final itinerary).
- Hotel: Hilton San Francisco Union Square, confirmation #123456789, check-in 3/16 after 3pm, checkout 3/20 11am. Ask for early check-in if booth setup completes earlier.
- Ground: Uber for Business account linked to Redwood corporate card (last 4 of card **** 4321). Use receipts for Concur.
- Booth: Booth C12 -- AV package scheduled with Conference AV vendor (Contact: Miguel Ramos, miguel.ramos@confav.com, +1-415-555-0199). AV pickup/setup 3/17 06:00-08:30.
- Shipping: Booth crate shipped to Moscone (tracking CHK-9882). Jordan coordinating crate arrival date 3/16.

Vendor contacts (quick)
- Hilton SF -- Group Reservations: grpreserv@hilton-sf.com, +1-415-555-0100, confirmation 123456789
- Conference AV (on-site): Miguel Ramos <miguel.ramos@confav.com>, +1-415-555-0199
- Catering (booth hospitality): CityCater Co -- order ref RED-BOOTH-34 (contact: priya@citycater.com)
- Promo / Swag vendor: PrintPerfect Ltd (order #PP-422), contact: leah@printperfect.com

Expense quick notes (finance / Concur)
- Accounting codes: PROD-TRAVEL, ENG-CONF, MARKETING-SWAG (use appropriate line item).
- Per-diem guidance: Use receipts for meals; limit for CA (no set per diem) -- keep itemized receipts.
- Card usage: Use Redwood corporate card where possible; for personal purchases, submit Concur within 5 business days after return.
- Receipts: Photo + upload to Concur mobile; label vendor and date in notes. Save electronic copies to this Drive folder after submission.
- Estimated budget (per head): travel $450, hotel $700 (4 nights), meals $200, incidentals $100, total ~ $1450 per person (budget flag: confirm with finance if > $1500).

Meetings & calendar slots (booked / tentative)
- 3/17 14:00 -- Acme AI (Nina) -- calibration chat + pilot discussion (room A3) -- confirmed
- 3/17 16:30 -- Vertex Labs (Evan) -- technical deep dive (booth) -- tentative
- 3/18 10:00 -- Summit Retail -- demo + pricing (coffee meeting) -- confirmed
- 3/18 13:00 -- internal sync: post-demo notes (30m) -- booth back room
- 3/19 11:00 -- follow-ups / open slots for walk-ins

Booth demo checklist (Samantha/Evan)
- Demo laptop: workstation + dongles (USB-C -> HDMI, mini DP)
- Local model artifacts: small demo model checkpoint (quantized), prompt sets saved locally (no network dependency)
- API keys: Use demo account keys (rotated), staged model endpoints (hosted) + Dedicated fallback config documented in Confluence
- Network: confirm booth wifi + backup hotspot (Verizon MiFi, charged)
- Slide deck: 5-slide pitch deck (PDF) + one-pager handouts (print 50)
- Swag: stickers, 200 postcards, 50 T-shirts size breakdown (Jordan to confirm counts)

Packing checklist
- Business cards, one-pager, slide PDFs on USB
- Laptop + charger, dongles, spare battery pack
- Booth toolkit: gaffer tape, zip ties, scissors, velcro, multi-tool
- Chargers for demo devices, extension strip (ask venue about power outlets)
- Personal: meds, toiletries, extra socks, formal blazer (evening dinners)

Action items before travel (by 3/10 ideally)
- Jordan: confirm swag quantities and shipment date to Moscone (J)
- Nina: finalize meeting calendar + share confirmed list with team (N)
- Evan: finalize demo artifacts + local fallback model (E)
- Samantha: confirm flight PNR and upload receipt to Drive; confirm corporate card assigned for on-site AV/catering charges (S)
- All: upload signed expense policy acknowledgement (2026) to HR portal before travel

Reimbursement / post-trip
- Submit Concur: itemized receipts + short note mapping to conference/project (e.g., MLConf2026 -- customer outreach).
- Expedite if total > $1500 (email finance@redwood-inference.com with subject EXP-Priority).
- Save digital receipts to Drive folder: shared path (this file lives in users/ but copy to shared_drives/product/events/MLConf-2026 when finalized).

Open questions / things to resolve
- Confirm flight PNR and itinerary -- current booking looks odd (double-check legs).
- Booth power supply location map from show organizer -- need outlet coordinates.
- Should we purchase additional headsets for demo (2 spare) -- approve under $120.

Notes to self (quick):
- Keep demos tight (2-3 short flows) -- focus on latency vs cost story and dedicated vs hosted fallbacks.
- Ask customers early about data residency needs -- note for Private deployment follow-ups.
- If any receipts missing, flag to finance with justification notes ASAP.

Misc quick refs:
- Slack thread: #events-mlconf-2026 (pin: on-site emergency contact list)
- Confluence: MLConf-2026-Redwood-Exhibits (final runbook + booth map)
- Jira: TRVL-4821 (travel approvals + expense policy)

-- end scratchpad --

(Will tidy into a formal travel doc once flights/hotel/AV confirmed.)
